Parish announcements

Notices from the office, the Council and our ministries — Sunday School news, a specific ask for volunteers, a parish event, ordinary parish business. Each one can carry a date after which it comes down on its own.

Urgent notice · sample

Sample — this is how an urgent notice appears

An urgent announcement sorts to the front of this grid and takes the red rule, so it is not read as ordinary parish business. It is meant for a weather closure, a service moved at short notice, or a death in the parish family. Set "urgent": true on an entry in data/parish-announcements.json.

From the office · sample

Sample — this is how an ordinary announcement appears

Announcements run newest first, each under a label saying what kind of notice it is, and each one can carry a date after which it comes down by itself rather than piling up. None of these is a real parish announcement yet; the two sample entries exist to show the Parish Council the shape of the thing.

Posted 9 August · until 31 December
Proposed — for Fr. John's review

Announcements would be posted by the parish office, each with a date after which it disappears on its own — so the page never shows a notice about an event that has already happened. Who may post, and what needs approval, is a decision for Fr. John and the Council.
